```{r prep-data, cache = FALSE}
### Load packages
library(brms)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidybayes)
library(patchwork)
library(rstan)
library(marginaleffects)
library(collapse)
library(grateful)

### Load custom functions
source("functions.R")

### Load clean and prepped data
source("data_prep.R")

```

# Analysis

## Vertical lobe

### Habitat and depth
```{r m1VL}
f <- bf(avgVL ~ mi(avgML) + avgCNS + depth.max*benthic + WoS + (1 | gr(phy.species, cov = cormat))) +
     bf(avgML | mi() ~ 1 + avgCNS + depth.max + benthic)

(m1.VL <- brms_func(f))
```

```{r}
plot(conditional_effects(m1.VL, effects = "depth.max:benthic", resp = "avgVL"), points = TRUE)
```

```{r}
plot(conditional_effects(m1.VL, effects = "benthic", resp = "avgVL"), points = TRUE)
```

### Depth categories
```{r m1cVL}
f <- bf(avgVL ~ mi(avgML) + avgCNS + depth_cat + WoS + (1 | gr(phy.species, cov = cormat))) +
     bf(avgML | mi() ~ 1 + avgCNS + depth_cat)

(m1c.VL <- brms_func(f))
```

```{r}
plot(conditional_effects(m1c.VL, effects = "depth_cat", resp = "avgVL"), points = TRUE, plot = FALSE)[[1]] +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=(c("shallow", "daily", "ontogenetic", "deep")))
```

```{r fm1cVL, dpi=600, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
# depth categories
mod <- m1c.VL
imp <- mod$data
resp <- "avgVL"
y_var <- sub("(\\D)(\\d+)", "\\1.\\2", resp)

expand.grid(list(depth_cat = 1:4)) |>
  mutate(avgML = 0, avgCNS = 0, WoS = 0) |> # set covariates to their means
  add_epred_draws(mod, resp = resp, re_formula = NA) |>
  gdensity_plot(x_var = depth_cat, 
           y_var = !!sym(y_var),
           data = imp) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cat4_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cat4_colors) +
  labs(x = "Depth category", y = "Vertical lobe size") +
  scale_x_discrete(label = c("shallow", "daily\n migration", "ontogenetic\n migration", "deep")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

### Age of sexual maturity
```{r m2VL}
f <- bf(avgVL ~ mi(avgML) + avgCNS + mi(lifespan.max) + mi(matage.max) + WoS + benthic + depth.mean + (1|gr(phy.species,cov=cormat))) + 
     bf(matage.max | mi() ~ 1 + mi(avgML) + mi(lifespan.max) + WoS + benthic + depth.mean) + 
     bf(lifespan.max | mi() ~ 1 + mi(avgML) + WoS + benthic + depth.mean) + 
     bf(avgML | mi() ~ 1 + avgCNS + benthic + depth.mean)

(m2.VL <- brms_func(f))
```

```{r}
plot(conditional_effects(m2.VL, effects = "matage.max", resp = "avgVL"), points = TRUE)
```

### Sociality
```{r m3VL}
f <- bf(avgVL ~ mi(avgML) + avgCNS + sociality.bin + WoS + benthic + depth.mean + (1|gr(phy.species,cov=cormat))) + 
     bf(avgML | mi() ~ 1 + avgCNS + benthic + depth.mean)

(m3.VL <- brms_func(f))
```

```{r}
plot(conditional_effects(m3.VL, effects = "sociality.bin", resp = "avgVL"), points = TRUE)
```

### Defense
```{r m4VL}
f <- bf(avgVL ~ mi(avgML) + avgCNS +  mi(defense.repertoire)*benthic + articles.read + depth.mean + pos.latmean + (1|gr(phy.species,cov=cormat))) +
     bf(avgML | mi() ~ 1 + avgCNS + benthic + depth.mean + pos.latmean)+
     bf(defense.repertoire | mi() ~ 1 + avgCNS + benthic + articles.read)

(m4.VL <- brms_func(f, constrain_imp = TRUE, vars = "defense.repertoire"))
```

```{r}
plot(conditional_effects(m4.VL, effects = "defense.repertoire:benthic", resp = "avgVL"), points = TRUE)
```

### Biolumninescence (NB: only relevant for the optic lobe)

```{r m8OPL}
f <- bf(avgOPL ~ mi(avgML) + avgCNS + biolum*depth_cat + (1 | gr(phy.species, cov = cormat))) +
     bf(avgML | mi() ~ 1 + avgCNS)

(m8.OPL <- brms_func(f))
```

```{r fm8OPL, dpi=600, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
# depth X biolum interaction
mod <- m8.OPL
imp <- mod$data
resp <- "avgOPL"
y_var <- sub("(\\D)(\\d+)", "\\1.\\2", resp)

(f.bl <- expand.grid(list(depth_cat = 1:4, biolum = 0:1)) |>
  mutate(avgML = 0, avgCNS = 0) |> # set covariates to their means
  add_epred_draws(mod, resp = resp, re_formula = NA) |>
  cat_plot(x_var = depth_cat, 
           y_var = !!sym(y_var),
           g_var = biolum,
           data = imp,
           interaction = TRUE) +
  labs(x = "Depth category", y = "Optic lobe size")  +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Bioluminescence",
                     values = c("0" = cat_colors[1], "1" = cat_colors[2]),
                     labels = c("Absent", "Present")) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Bioluminescence",
                     values = c("0" = cat_colors[1], "1" = cat_colors[2]),
                     labels = c("Absent", "Present")) +
  scale_x_discrete(label = c("shallow", "daily\n migration", "ontogenetic\n migration", "deep")) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom"))
```

```{r fm8OPL-lsmeans}
# posterior contrasts/marginal mean differences (depth_cat by biolum)
expand.grid(list(depth_cat = as.factor(1:4), biolum = as.factor(0:1))) |>
  mutate(avgML = 0, avgCNS = 0) |> 
  as.data.frame() |>
  marginaleffects::avg_comparisons(model = mod, 
                                   variables = "depth_cat", 
                                   by = "biolum", 
                                   re_formula = NA, 
                                   resp = resp)

# posterior contrasts/marginal mean differences (biolum by depth_cat)
expand.grid(list(depth_cat = as.factor(1:4), biolum = as.factor(0:1))) |>
  mutate(avgML = 0, avgCNS = 0) |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  marginaleffects::avg_comparisons(model = mod, 
                                   variables = "biolum",
                                   by = "depth_cat",
                                   re_formula = NA, 
                                   resp = resp)
```

```{r m2minavgCNS}
     bf(lifespan.min | mi() ~ 1 + mi(avgML) + WoS + benthic + depth.mean) + 
     bf(avgML | mi() ~ 1 + benthic + depth.mean + pos.latmean)

(m2min.avgCNS <- brms_func(f))
```

```{r}
plot(conditional_effects(m2min.avgCNS, effects = "matage.min", resp = "avgCNS"), points = TRUE)
```

```{r fm1cVLC, dpi=600, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}

expand.grid(list(depth_cat = 1:4)) |>

  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# Report plots

## Descriptives

### Lobe percentage to total CNS

```{r}
# Create bar charts
bardat <- dat |> 
  select(species, benthic, depth.mean, depth_cat, avgCNS, avgVL, avgOPL, avgVLC) |>
  mutate(pVL = (avgVL/avgCNS)*100,
         pVL2 = (avgVL/(avgCNS-avgOPL))*100,
         pOPL = (avgOPL/avgCNS)*100,
         pVLC = (avgVLC/avgCNS)*100,
         benthic = as.factor(benthic),
         depth = depth.mean,
         depth.cat = as.factor(depth_cat))
```

```{r fOPLbar, fig.height=10, dpi = 600, fig.width=8}
# optic lobe
bardat |> ggplot(aes(x = reorder(species, -pOPL), y = pOPL, fill = benthic, color = benthic)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", alpha = 0.65) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Habitat",
                    values = c("0" = "#2C70FE", "1" = "#feba2c"),
                    labels = c("Pelagic", "Benthic")) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Habitat",
                     values = c("0" = "#2C70FE", "1" = "#feba2c"),
                     labels = c("Pelagic", "Benthic")) +
  theme_classic() +
  coord_flip() + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,100), labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) + 
  labs(x = "Species", y = "OPL percentage of total CNS",
       title = "Optic lobe percentage of total CNS")
```

### Phylogenetic signal of lobe proportion to total CNS

```{r fOPLphy, dpi = 600, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
#ASR and signal----
library(phytools)
library(viridis)
library(plotrix)

#decomposition of phylogenetic distance matrix into orthogonal vectors (PVRs)
phylo.vectors = PVR::PVRdecomp(cephtreeMCC)

# optic lobe
phydat <- dat[c("phy.species","avgOPL","avgCNS")]
phydat <- mice::complete(mice::mice(phydat)) #imputation

#calculate "EQ" (actually, log(lobe/CNS) proportion)
phydat$EQ <- log(phydat$avgOPL / phydat$avgCNS)
logEQ <- as.vector(phydat$EQ)
names(logEQ) <- d$phy.species

#ancestral state reconstruction and plot
ASR <- contMap(cephtreeMCC, logEQ, plot=FALSE, title = "avgOPL")

n_cols <- n_distinct(logEQ)

ASR$cols[1:length(ASR$cols)]<-colorRampPalette(c("#feba2c","#d6556d","#2a0593"))(length(ASR$cols))

# Plot the mapped characters with the new colors
plot(ASR, type="fan", outline=FALSE, legend = 0.7*max(nodeHeights(cephtreeMCC)),
  fsize = c(0.7, 0.7))

title(main = "Optic lobe size relative to CNS (log ratio)",line = -1)
```

```{r fVLphy, dpi = 600, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
# vertical lobe
phydat <- dat[c("phy.species","avgVL","avgCNS")]
phydat <- mice::complete(mice::mice(phydat)) #imputation

#calculate "EQ" (actually, lobe to CNS proportion)
phydat$EQ <- log(phydat$avgVL/phydat$avgCNS)
logEQ <- as.vector(phydat$EQ)
names(logEQ) <- d$phy.species

#ancestral state reconstruction and plot
ASR <- contMap(cephtreeMCC, logEQ, plot=FALSE)

n_cols <- n_distinct(logEQ)
length(ASR$cols)

ASR$cols[1:1001]<-colorRampPalette(c("#feba2c","#d6556d","#2a0593"))(1001)

# Plot the mapped characters with the new colors
plot(ASR, type="fan", outline=FALSE, legend = 0.7*max(nodeHeights(cephtreeMCC)),
  fsize = c(0.7, 0.7))

title(main = "Vertical lobe size relative to CNS (log ratio)", line = -1)
```

## Panel: VL

```{r}
# depth X benthic interaction
mod <- m1.VL
imp <- mod$data
resp <- "avgVL"
y_var <- sub("(\\D)(\\d+)", "\\1.\\2", resp)

f.db <- expand.grid(list(depth.max = -4:2, benthic = 0:1)) |>
  mutate(avgML = 0, WoS = 0, avgCNS = 0) |> # set covariates to their means
  add_epred_draws(mod, resp = resp, re_formula = NA) |>
  lineribbon_plot(x_var = depth.max, 
                  y_var = !!sym(y_var), 
                  data = imp,
                  interaction = TRUE) +
  labs(x = "Maximum depth", y = "Vertical lobe size") 

### benthic  
f.b <- rbind(transform(imp, benthic = 0),
             transform(imp, benthic = 1)) |>
  mutate(avgML = 0, WoS = 0, avgCNS = 0, benthic = as.factor(benthic)) |> 
  add_epred_draws(mod, resp = resp, re_formula = NA) |>
  gdensity_plot(x_var = benthic, 
           y_var = !!sym(y_var), 
           data = imp) + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("pelagic", "benthic")) + 
  labs(x = "Habitat", y = "Vertical lobe size")
```
